description: Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha - List of the Roads and Lanes owned by Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with the declaration of roads and lanes as property owned by the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of land coordinates, measurements, and ownership claims related to land and property matters, which falls under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land boundary specifications.
